description: Edges of the per-agency generation rule: exactly one agency (the floor above zero, since the component exists only per identified agency), no charges ever filed so the case-number sentence must be omitted, the acquittal branch of the disposition paragraph, and segRoute = both so the court application is produced alongside. Protected fields stay blank.

chargeData.chargeDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF WHAT THEY WERE ARRESTED FOR]
chargeData.arrestOffenceDescription: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION OF WHAT THEY WERE ARRESTED FOR]

recipients.agencyName: [AGENCY 1 NAME — PARTICIPANT'S OWN ANSWER; NO SOURCE NAMES ANY KENTUCKY AGENCY]

screeningAnswers.segOffence: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN DESCRIPTION — NOT SUPPLIED BY LEGALEASE]
screeningAnswers.segDispositionType: [PARTICIPANT'S OWN STATEMENT OF FACT — found innocent — NOT SUPPLIED, DERIVED OR INFERRED BY LEGALEASE]
screeningAnswers.segAlreadyExpunged: no — participant states the records are not expunged and states they are not eligible under KRS 431.076 or KRS 431.078
screeningAnswers.segAgencies: one agency, named by the participant

boundaryUnderTest: Per-agency floor: exactly one agency identified. The component is conditional on segAgencies being non-empty, so one is the lowest value at which any letter exists.
segChargesFiled = no: the conditional case-number sentence must be omitted entirely and the letter must still read correctly.

Disposition branch: 'found innocent', the first of the three KRS 17.142(1) dispositions and the one that most often belongs under KRS 431.076 instead — so this fixture also exercises the routing check that must run before any letter is produced.
segRoute = both: the registry states the routes are independent and a participant may use both, so this component must coexist with the court application.
Waiting period edge: the registry records a waiting period of 'none', so no elapsed-time value is set.

partyDataFieldNote: partyData uses the PleadingRenderInput field names petitionerName / petitionerAddress / otherNamesUsed. The role label for this track is set by presentation.movantRole in the config (Movant on the void-and-seal tracks, Applicant on the KRS 17.142(2) application), not by the fixture key name.
